reference: Splatoon 3 Ver. 11.3.0 Heavy Splatling (バレルスピナー), training-range enemy-target capture
provenance: Third-party capture, JPEG, downscaled. Not Nintendo's official 1280x720 photo. Spread value at capture time is unknown.
method: Original JPEG RGB pixels. ROI [350,150,430,205]. Select min(R,G,B)>120 and max-min<35; 8-connected components with at least 5 pixels. Bounds are the detected bright pixels, so bracket centroids are partial (about 1px uncertainty plus JPEG blur).

derivation.note: outerCorner = round(scale x mean outer extent about the ring centre; x mean 29.0, y mean 20.0). Arm length is about 10 reference px. Brackets are drawn only as outer corners, so the inside arms do not reach the charge ring (r=21, segments to r=25).

unverified: Spread value that the capture corresponds to (sp=0 envelope in INKWAVE is not known to match S3 at rest).
Mapping of INKWAVE's track ring radius to S3's gauge radius (assumed equal scale through the ring).
Bracket stroke width and rounding (2px border and 3px radius are approximations).
Spread-to-pixel rate is unchanged from the existing INKWAVE model (1px per spread unit radially).
